name: taskLoss
doc: 多任务损失：任务 `i` 在参数 θ 处的损失。
stmt: def taskLoss {ι : Type*} (L : ι → ℝ → ℝ) (θ : ℝ) (i : ι) : ℝ
proof: L i θ

name: forgetting
doc: 任务 `i` 的遗忘量：参数变化后与变化前的损失差。
stmt: def forgetting {ι : Type*} (L : ι → ℝ → ℝ) (i : ι) (θafter θbefore : ℝ) : ℝ
proof: L i θafter - L i θbefore

name: IsLip
doc: 任务 `i` 的损失以常数 Λ 是 Lipschitz 的。
stmt: def IsLip {ι : Type*} (L : ι → ℝ → ℝ) (i : ι) (Λ : ℝ) : Prop
proof: ∀ a b : ℝ, |L i a - L i b| ≤ Λ * |a - b|

name: ewcPenalty
doc: EWC 的 Fisher 加权二次惩罚：`(F/2)(θ − θ_old)²`。
stmt: def ewcPenalty (F θ θold : ℝ) : ℝ

name: replayGradientBudget
stmt: def replayGradientBudget (η G : ℝ) (T : ℕ) : ℝ
proof: (T : ℝ) * η * G

name: forgetting_bound
stmt:
theorem forgetting_bound {ι : Type*} (L : ι → ℝ → ℝ) (i : ι) (Λ θafter θbefore : ℝ)
    (hLip : IsLip L i Λ) :
    |forgetting L i θafter θbefore| ≤ Λ * |θafter - θbefore|
proof: hLip θafter θbefore

name: forgetting_self
stmt:
theorem forgetting_self {ι : Type*} (L : ι → ℝ → ℝ) (i : ι) (θ : ℝ) :
    forgetting L i θ θ = 0
proof:
by
  simp [forgetting]

name: forgetting_bound_of_drift
doc: 漂移被 d 界住 ⟹ 遗忘被 Λ·d 界住。
stmt:
theorem forgetting_bound_of_drift {ι : Type*} (L : ι → ℝ → ℝ) (i : ι) (Λ θafter θbefore d : ℝ)
    (hΛ : 0 ≤ Λ) (hLip : IsLip L i Λ) (hdrift : |θafter - θbefore| ≤ d) :
    |forgetting L i θafter θbefore| ≤ Λ * d
proof:
by
  calc
    |forgetting L i θafter θbefore| ≤ Λ * |θafter - θbefore| := forgetting_bound L i Λ _ _ hLip
    _ ≤ Λ * d := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdrift hΛ

name: ewcPenalty_nonneg
stmt: theorem ewcPenalty_nonneg (F θ θold : ℝ) (hF : 0 ≤ F) : 0 ≤ ewcPenalty F θ θold
proof:
by
  unfold ewcPenalty
  exact mul_nonneg (div_nonneg hF (by norm_num)) (sq_nonneg _)

name: ewc_drift_bound
stmt:
theorem ewc_drift_bound (F θ θold lam : ℝ) (hF : 0 < F)
    (hpen : ewcPenalty F θ θold ≤ lam) :
    |θ - θold| ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * lam / F)
proof:
by
  have hsq : (θ - θold) ^ 2 ≤ 2 * lam / F := by
    have hmul : (F / 2) * (θ - θold) ^ 2 * 2 ≤ lam * 2 :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hpen (by norm_num)
    have hkey : F * (θ - θold) ^ 2 ≤ 2 * lam := by
      unfold ewcPenalty at hmul
      linarith
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hF]
    nlinarith [hkey]
  calc
    |θ - θold| = Real.sqrt ((θ - θold) ^ 2) := (Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs _).symm
    _ ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * lam / F) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hsq

name: ewc_forgetting_bound
doc: **EWC 遗忘界**：Lipschitz Λ + 惩罚预算 λ ⟹ `|遗忘| ≤ Λ·√(2λ/F)`（与 T 无关）。
stmt:
theorem ewc_forgetting_bound {ι : Type*} (L : ι → ℝ → ℝ) (i : ι) (Λ F θ θold lam : ℝ)
    (hΛ : 0 ≤ Λ) (hF : 0 < F) (hLip : IsLip L i Λ)
    (hpen : ewcPenalty F θ θold ≤ lam) :
    |forgetting L i θ θold| ≤ Λ * Real.sqrt (2 * lam / F)
proof:
by
  calc
    |forgetting L i θ θold| ≤ Λ * |θ - θold| := forgetting_bound L i Λ _ _ hLip
    _ ≤ Λ * Real.sqrt (2 * lam / F) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (ewc_drift_bound F θ θold lam hF hpen) hΛ

name: drift_bound_of_step
stmt:
theorem drift_bound_of_step {θ : ℕ → ℝ} (D : ℝ)
    (hstep : ∀ t : ℕ, |θ (t + 1) - θ t| ≤ D) :
    ∀ T : ℕ, |θ T - θ 0| ≤ (T : ℝ) * D
proof:
by
  intro T
  induction T with
  | zero => simp
  | succ T ih =>
      calc
        |θ (T + 1) - θ 0| = |(θ (T + 1) - θ T) + (θ T - θ 0)| := by
          congr 1
          ring
        _ ≤ |θ (T + 1) - θ T| + |θ T - θ 0| := abs_add _ _
        _ ≤ D + (T : ℝ) * D := add_le_add (hstep T) ih
        _ = ((T : ℝ) + 1) * D := by ring
        _ = ((T + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * D := by rw [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]

name: replay_bound
doc: **回放遗忘界**：每步漂移 ≤ ηG ⟹ `|遗忘| ≤ Λ·T·η·G`（随 T 线性增长）。
stmt:
theorem replay_bound {ι : Type*} (L : ι → ℝ → ℝ) (i : ι) (Λ η G : ℝ) (T : ℕ)
    (θ : ℕ → ℝ) (hΛ : 0 ≤ Λ) (hLip : IsLip L i Λ)
    (hstep : ∀ t : ℕ, |θ (t + 1) - θ t| ≤ η * G) :
    |forgetting L i (θ T) (θ 0)| ≤ Λ * ((T : ℝ) * η * G)
proof:
by
  have hdrift : |θ T - θ 0| ≤ (T : ℝ) * (η * G) := drift_bound_of_step (η * G) hstep T
  calc
    |forgetting L i (θ T) (θ 0)| ≤ Λ * |θ T - θ 0| := forgetting_bound L i Λ _ _ hLip
    _ ≤ Λ * ((T : ℝ) * (η * G)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdrift hΛ
    _ = Λ * ((T : ℝ) * η * G) := by ring

name: replayGradientBudget_eq
doc: 回放预算 `replayGradientBudget η G T = T·η·G`。
stmt:
lemma replayGradientBudget_eq (η G : ℝ) (T : ℕ) :
    replayGradientBudget η G T = (T : ℝ) * η * G
proof: rfl

name: replay_forgetting_unbounded
doc:
**无正则的遗忘无界**：`Λ > 0` 时 `Λ·T` 随 T 无界（灾难性遗忘的量化表述）：
    `∀ B, ∃ T, B < Λ·T`。
stmt:
theorem replay_forgetting_unbounded (Λ : ℝ) (hΛ : 0 < Λ) :
    ∀ B : ℝ, ∃ T : ℕ, B < Λ * (T : ℝ)
proof:
by
  intro B
  rcases exists_nat_gt (B / Λ) with ⟨N, hN⟩
  refine ⟨N, ?_⟩
  have h := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hN hΛ
  rw [div_mul_cancel₀ B (ne_of_gt hΛ)] at h
  linarith [h]

             
                                                    
                                                  
                                                
                                                             
                                          
                                                

end Lattice

name: infoNCE
doc: InfoNCE 对比损失：−log softmax(s/τ)_i（正样本的负对数 softmax 概率）。
stmt: noncomputable def infoNCE {n : ℕ} (s : Fin n → ℝ) (τ : ℝ) (i : Fin n) : ℝ
proof: -Real.log (softmax (fun j => s j / τ) i)

name: infonce_eq_neg_log_softmaxTemp
stmt:
theorem infonce_eq_neg_log_softmaxTemp {n : ℕ} (s : Fin n → ℝ) (τ : ℝ) (i : Fin n) :
    infoNCE s τ i = -Real.log (softmaxTemp s τ i)
proof:
by
  rw [infoNCE, softmax_temp_scale]

name: infonce_eq_ce
doc: InfoNCE 是交叉熵的实例：−log softmax_i = CE(onehot_i, softmax s/τ)（`ce_onehot_eq_neg_log`）。
stmt:
theorem infonce_eq_ce {n : ℕ} (s : Fin n → ℝ) (τ : ℝ) (i : Fin n) :
    infoNCE s τ i = crossEntropy (onehot i) (softmax (fun j => s j / τ))
proof:
by
  rw [infoNCE, ce_onehot_eq_neg_log i (softmax (fun j => s j / τ)) (softmax_pos _ i)]

name: infonce_nonneg
stmt:
theorem infonce_nonneg {n : ℕ} (s : Fin n → ℝ) (τ : ℝ) (i : Fin n) :
    0 ≤ infoNCE s τ i
proof:
by
  haveI : Nonempty (Fin n) := ⟨i⟩
  have hpos : 0 < softmax (fun j => s j / τ) i := softmax_pos _ i
  have hle1 : softmax (fun j => s j / τ) i ≤ 1 := by
    have hsum := softmax_sum_one (fun j => s j / τ)
    have hsingle : softmax (fun j => s j / τ) i
        ≤ ∑ j, softmax (fun j => s j / τ) j :=
      Finset.single_le_sum
        (fun j _ => le_of_lt (softmax_pos (fun j => s j / τ) j)) (Finset.mem_univ i)
    linarith
  have hlog : Real.log (softmax (fun j => s j / τ) i) ≤ 0 := by
    have := Real.log_le_log hpos hle1
    rwa [Real.log_one] at this
  rw [infoNCE]
  linarith

name: infonce_le_log_card_of_max
stmt:
theorem infonce_le_log_card_of_max {n : ℕ} (s : Fin n → ℝ) (τ : ℝ) (i : Fin n)
    (hτ : 0 < τ) (hmax : ∀ j, s j ≤ s i) :
    infoNCE s τ i ≤ Real.log n
proof:
by
  haveI : Nonempty (Fin n) := ⟨i⟩
  have hnpos : 0 < (n : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.zero_le i.val) i.isLt)
  have hden : ∑ j, Real.exp (s j / τ) ≤ (n : ℝ) * Real.exp (s i / τ) := by
    calc ∑ j, Real.exp (s j / τ) ≤ ∑ _j : Fin n, Real.exp (s i / τ) := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum
          intro j _
          exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (hmax j) (le_of_lt hτ))
      _ = (n : ℝ) * Real.exp (s i / τ) := by
          simp [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
  have hnumpos : 0 < Real.exp (s i / τ) := Real.exp_pos _
  have hdenpos : 0 < ∑ j, Real.exp (s j / τ) := softmax_denom_pos _
  have hfrac : 1 / (n : ℝ) ≤ softmax (fun j => s j / τ) i := by
    show 1 / (n : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp (s i / τ) / ∑ j, Real.exp (s j / τ)
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hnpos hdenpos]
    simpa [mul_comm] using hden
  have hlog := Real.log_le_log (div_pos one_pos hnpos) hfrac
  have h1n : Real.log (1 / (n : ℝ)) = -Real.log n := by
    rw [one_div, Real.log_inv]
  rw [infoNCE]
  linarith

name: infonce_le_log_one_add_of_gap
stmt:
theorem infonce_le_log_one_add_of_gap {n : ℕ} (s : Fin n → ℝ) (τ Δ : ℝ) (i : Fin n)
    (hτ : 0 < τ) (_hΔ : 0 < Δ) (hgap : ∀ j, j ≠ i → s j ≤ s i - Δ) :
    infoNCE s τ i ≤ Real.log (1 + ((n : ℝ) - 1) * Real.exp (-(Δ / τ)))
proof:
by
  haveI : Nonempty (Fin n) := ⟨i⟩
  have hn1 : 1 ≤ n := Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.zero_le i.val) i.isLt
  have hn1' : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn1
                
  have hcard : (Finset.univ.erase i).card = n - 1 := by
    rw [Finset.card_erase_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ i), Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
  have hcast : ((n - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) = (n : ℝ) - 1 := by
    rw [Nat.cast_sub hn1, Nat.cast_one]
  have herase : ∑ j in Finset.univ.erase i, Real.exp (s j / τ)
      ≤ ((n : ℝ) - 1) * (Real.exp (s i / τ) * Real.exp (-(Δ / τ))) := by
    calc ∑ j in Finset.univ.erase i, Real.exp (s j / τ)
        ≤ ∑ _j in Finset.univ.erase i,
            (Real.exp (s i / τ) * Real.exp (-(Δ / τ))) := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum
          intro j hj
          have hji : j ≠ i := Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hj
          have hle : s j ≤ s i - Δ := hgap j hji
          have h1 : s j / τ ≤ (s i - Δ) / τ := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hle (le_of_lt hτ)
          have h2 : (s i - Δ) / τ = s i / τ + (-(Δ / τ)) := by ring
          calc Real.exp (s j / τ) ≤ Real.exp (s i / τ + (-(Δ / τ))) :=
                Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by rw [← h2]; exact h1)
            _ = Real.exp (s i / τ) * Real.exp (-(Δ / τ)) := Real.exp_add _ _
      _ = ((n : ℝ) - 1) * (Real.exp (s i / τ) * Real.exp (-(Δ / τ))) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_const, hcard, nsmul_eq_mul, hcast]
             
  have hZeq : ∑ j, Real.exp (s j / τ)
      = Real.exp (s i / τ) + ∑ j in Finset.univ.erase i, Real.exp (s j / τ

name: infonce_directional_deriv
stmt:
theorem infonce_directional_deriv {n : ℕ} (s v : Fin n → ℝ) (τ : ℝ) (i : Fin n)
    (_hτ : τ ≠ 0) :
    deriv (fun t : ℝ => -Real.log (softmax (fun j => (s j + t * v j) / τ) i)) 0
      = (1 / τ) * ((∑ j, softmax (fun j => s j / τ) j * v j) - v i)
proof:
by
  have hfun : (fun t : ℝ => -Real.log (softmax (fun j => (s j + t * v j) / τ) i))
      = (fun t : ℝ => -Real.log (softmax (fun j => s j / τ + t * (v j / τ)) i)) := by
    funext t
    have h : (fun j : Fin n => (s j + t * v j) / τ)
        = (fun j : Fin n => s j / τ + t * (v j / τ)) := by
      funext j
      ring
    rw [h]
  have hkey : (fun t : ℝ => -Real.log (softmax (fun j => s j / τ + t * (v j / τ)) i))
      = (fun t : ℝ => -Real.log
          (softmax ((fun j : Fin n => s j / τ) + t • (fun j : Fin n => v j / τ)) i)) := by
    funext t
    have h : (fun j : Fin n => s j / τ + t * (v j / τ))
        = ((fun j : Fin n => s j / τ) + t • (fun j : Fin n => v j / τ)) := by
      funext j
      simp [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [h]
  rw [hfun, hkey, softmax_ce_directional_deriv (fun j => s j / τ) (fun j => v j / τ) i]
  have hsum : (∑ j, softmax (fun j => s j / τ) j * (v j / τ))
      = (∑ j, softmax (fun j => s j / τ) j * v j) / τ := by
    have hcong : (∑ j, softmax (fun j => s j / τ) j * (v j / τ))
        = ∑ j, (softmax (fun j => s j / τ) j * v j) / τ :=
      Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => by ring)
    rw [hcong, ← Finset.sum_div]
  rw [hsum, ← sub_div, div_eq_mul_inv]
  ring

end Lattice
